red_flags.quote: Party B has the right of first refusal to lease the property.
When the contract expires and Party B fails to find another location to move to, Party B shall negotiate with Party A to extend the lease term.
If Party B wants to exchange the use of the property with a third party, Party B shall obtain the consent of Party A, and Party A shall support Party B’s reasonable requests.
If Party B subleases the rented space to any other party without the consent of Party A, Party A has the right to request Party B to stop the sublease and terminate this contract.

After expiration of this lease contract, if Party B continues to use the property without the consent of Party A, besides regular rent Party B shall pay to Party A the penalty equivalent to 0.05% of the rent for each day after expiration date, and Party A keeps the right to terminate the lease contract.
Party B has the right to refuse to pay Party A any other expense except rent.
